items.title: Workday (WDAY), What Is Behind The Fresh Attention?
items.summary: Recognition from Gartner as a Leader and Customers' Choice in cloud ERP put fresh attention on Workday (WDAY). This industry endorsement gives investors another reference point as they assess the software group's valuation. The Gartner recognition comes during a mixed period for Workday. The share price is at US$201.84 after a 90 day share price return of 18.56%, which contrasts with a 1 year total shareholder return decline of 13.04%.
